title: The Thirsty Land
summary: Learn to shape the island: raise and lower the ground, divert a river, and bring dead soil back to life.
briefing: Your people are few and the earth is tired.
A god shapes the world before shaping its peoples. Learn the land first.
Use Dig and Raise to reshape the ground. Use the River tool to steer water where it is needed.

quests.title: Shape the earth
quests.description: Raise and lower the ground with the Dig and Raise tools.

objectives.text: Reshape the terrain (use Dig or Raise)

quests.title: Move the waters
quests.description: Grab a watercourse with the River tool and steer it across the land.

objectives.text: Divert a river with the River tool

quests.title: Green the wasteland
quests.description: Water kills deserts. Steer the river through barren ground and watch it return to life.

objectives.text: Restore desertified land by watering it
